nativeBoundary.identityBinding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 document text plus document id, wrapper version, and coordinate unit

comparisonContract.independentEdits: Non-overlapping actions captured from one original document may be applied in descending original-offset order.
comparisonContract.lengthChangingEdits: A length-changing edit must not corrupt a later original-coordinate edit when both are applied as one batch.
comparisonContract.conflicts: Overlapping replacements and mutually exclusive alternatives are rejected explicitly without selecting an application order.
comparisonContract.reanalysis: After one action changes the document, an old second action is stale; reanalysis must produce a fresh action bound to current text.
comparisonContract.reapplication: An old action is rejected after successful correction, including when its replacement would be idempotent or the current text has the same length.
comparisonContract.nativeContract: The campaign validates consumer composition around individual native actions and does not require a native batch-edit field.

revisionHistory.reason: Compile-only correction: import Musoq.Parser so the test-local overlap cases can construct TextSpan values; candidate cases and expectations are unchanged.
